Frequently Asked Questions — Dublin Concrete Services

How much does concrete cutting cost in Dublin, CA?

Concrete cutting in Dublin typically costs $500 – $3,500. The exact cost depends on the type of cut, thickness of the concrete, accessibility, and whether rebar is present. Most Alameda County projects require a free on-site assessment for an accurate quote. Call (855) 288-7767 for a free estimate.

Do I need a permit for concrete cutting in Dublin?

California requires a C-8 (Concrete) or C-12 (Earthwork and Paving) license for concrete cutting. Waterproofing requires a C-39 (Roofing) or C-57 (Waterproofing) license. Permits required in most jurisdictions. In Dublin, permits are typically required for structural concrete cutting (load-bearing walls, foundations). Decorative or non-structural cutting may not require a permit. Our contractors can help you determine permit requirements and handle the permitting process.

How much does waterproofing cost in Dublin, California?

Waterproofing in Dublin typically costs $5,000 – $20,000. The exact cost depends on the type of waterproofing (interior vs exterior), the size of the area, severity of water issues, and accessibility.
